title: Decision Nº 050/001/2003 CC.D of January 15, 2003
text:
KINGDOM OF CAMBODIA 
Nation Religion King 
 
 
The Constitutional Council 
 ***** 
 CASE 
Nº 056/010/2002 
Of December 26, 2002 
Decision 
Nº 050/001/2003 CC.D 
Of January 15, 2003 
 
The Constitutional Council 
 
- Seen the Constitution of the Kingdom of Cambodia 
 
- Seen Preah Reach Kram Nº CS/RKM/0498/06 of April 8, 1998 on the 
Organization and the Functioning of the Constitutional Council; 
 
- Seen Preah Reach Kram Nº NS/RKM/0301/05 of March 19, 2001 on Commune 
 Administration; 
 
- Seen the letter of December 24, 2002 of 13 Deputies of SAM RAINSY Party to 
 Mr. BIN CHHIN, President of the Constitutional Council, requesting the 
 Constitutional Council to interpret article 30 of the law on Commune 
 Administration, which was received by the Constitutional Council on December 
 26, 2002; 
 
Having heard the reporting member, 
Having deliberated in compliance with the law, 
- Whereas 13 Deputies, the number superior to one_tenth (1/10x122), request the 
Constitutional Council to interpret article 30 of the law on Commune 
Administration; that this request is inconformity with the articles 136 N and 141 
N of the Constitution, therefore admissible; 
 
- Whereas the Commune Council is not only the representative body of citizens in 
its commune but also a state agency by appointment or by mandate from state 
authority (article 42). As citizens’ representative and within the framewor k of 
the decentralization policy, the Commune Council plays an essential role in the 
local affairs: ensuring the public order, the public services, the comfort and the 
wellbeing of citizens, the economic and the social development, the 
environment protec tion etc. As State Agency, the Commune Council has to 
respect and execute the instructions of the high hierarchies; 
 
- Whereas the article 30 (paragraph 1 and 2) of the law on Commune 
Administration stipulates that the Commune Council shall recruit chiefs of 
village (Mephum), that the Mephum has to appoint a deputy chief and an 
assistant member, and that paragraph 3 also explicitly stipulates: «The Minister 
of Interior has to issue directive on the modalities and the procedures for the 
recruitment of the c hiefs of village (Mephum), their taking office, their 
replacement and the nomination of Mephum’s assistant»; whereas the article 86, 
in the transitional provision, affirmed furthermore that «The recruitment of 
Mephum (chiefs of village) must be done...in a ccordance with the modalities 
and the procedures as stipulated in article 30 of this law»; 
 
- Whereas the law on Commune Administration does not limit the time for the 
Minister of Interior to issue the directives related to this matter, but there is a 
deadline for other matters, limited to 60 months at the latest; that besides, the 
law on the Commune Administration requires the Ministry of Interior to issue 
around 20 directives to promote the efficiency of this decentralization policy; 
 
- Whereas «The National Committee to support the Commune» headed by the 
Minister of Interior and created by the article 87 of the law on the Commune 
Administration, in order to facilitate the implementation of the decentralization 
policy has adequate competence (article 88) in finding solutions or in issuing 
directives within a reasonable time; 
 
- Whereas following the article 44, the Commune Council as a state agent can 
receive power delegation from the state authority to carry out the affairs, except 
in the domains sti pulated in the article 45, which are relevant to the competence 
of central authorities; 
 
- Whereas the Commune Council, as a state agent, shall refer to the Minister of 
Interior for principled directives on recruiting chiefs of village (Mephum), even 
if temporarily. The Minister of Interior has to respond to this request within a 
reasonable time; 
 
Decides 
 
Article 1: The article 30 of the law on Commune Administration shall be interpreted in 
Compliance with the above -mentioned motives. 
 
Article 2: This decision made in the plenary session of the Constitutional Council in 
Phnom Penh on January 15, 2003 shall be final without recourse, shall have 
authority over all instituted powers stipulated in the Constitution and shall be 
published in the«Journal Officiel». 
 
 
 Phnom Penh, January 15, 2003 
 For the Constitutional Council 
 The President 
 
 Signed and Sealed 
 
 BIN CHHIN 
 
 
 (Non -official translation)
summary: Decision Nº 050/001/2003 CC.D of January 15, 2003 (13 deputies from SAM RAINSY Party, requests to interpret article 30 of the law on Commune Administration)
